title: Spatial Shot-Chart Embeddings + LSTM Brier-Loss Calibration

source_papers: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting (MDPI 2026)
Stacked Ensemble for NBA Game Outcome Prediction (Nature Scientific Reports 2025)
ML for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA (MDPI Computation 2025)
Forecasting NCAA Basketball: LSTM vs Transformer (arXiv 2025)
findings_summary.key_insight_1: Spatial shot-chart embeddings provide COMPLEMENTARY information beyond team stats — ablation without shot charts showed consistent decrease in both discrimination AND calibration
findings_summary.key_insight_2: LSTM trained with Brier loss (not BCE) shows superior PROBABILITY CALIBRATION vs BCE-trained models
findings_summary.key_insight_3: Uncertainty-aware LSTM + Monte Carlo Dropout is best for betting: yields calibrated sequential probabilities
findings_summary.key_insight_4: CalibratedClassifierCV with auto sigmoid/isotonic selection consistently reduces ECE to ~0.051
findings_summary.key_insight_5: Best published Brier scores: LR=0.200, XGBoost=0.200, CNN=0.221 — suggesting our target of <0.21837 is achievable

proposals.title: Add Shot-Chart Zone Features (Cat47)
proposals.description: Add spatial shot zone features as category 47 in engine.py. For each team: zone-wise FGA%, FG%, 3PA rate, paint vs mid-range vs 3pt distribution over last 5/10/20 games. Encode as 60 features per team (home/away) = 120 new features.

implementation.method: Add _shot_zone_features(team_id, n_games) using nba_api endpoints: shotchartdetail or leaguedashteamshotlocations

proposals.rationale: Published ablation (MDPI 2026): removing shot-chart embeddings from best model caused Brier to rise from 0.220 to 0.228 (+0.008). Direct analog for tree-based models.
proposals.risk: LOW — additive feature, won't break existing model

proposals.title: Add CalibratedClassifierCV Post-Processing
proposals.description: Wrap best models in CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=5) after GA finds best feature set. Auto-selects sigmoid vs isotonic via Brier score. Expected ECE improvement from ~0.10 to ~0.05.

implementation.method: After model.fit(), apply CalibratedClassifierCV; evaluate Brier on val set with/without

proposals.rationale: All 2025-2026 NBA ML papers use CalibratedClassifierCV — it's the standard post-processing step. For tree models with Platt scaling (sigmoid) or isotonic regression, typical Brier improvement: 0.002-0.005.
proposals.risk: LOW — eval-only change to existing models

proposals.title: Strict Chronological Walk-Forward with 2024-25 Test Set
proposals.description: Current GA evaluates on entire dataset. Research shows strict chronological partitioning (train ≤ 2023, val 2024, test 2025) prevents data leakage and better reflects real-world deployment. Add season-split evaluation to Brier calculation.

implementation.method: Add is_current_season flag; separate eval_games into historical (train/val) and current (test); report both Brier scores

proposals.rationale: MDPI and IEEE papers both use strict chronological splits. Our walk-forward already does this but GA fitness uses all 9,551 games — need to verify no temporal leakage.
proposals.risk: MEDIUM — could change perceived Brier scores if leakage exists

cross_project_port.note: CalibratedClassifierCV (P2) directly portable to nomos-political-alpha evolve.py — PA4 best model (XGBoost Brier=0.25) would benefit from isotonic calibration. Implement after zero-padding fix restores full feature space.

next_action: Implement P2 (CalibratedClassifierCV) on S10 first — lowest complexity, highest confidence improvement. P1 (shot charts) requires data pipeline work but highest potential Brier gain.
